<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# N is at [38,10]. Container is [38,8]-[43,13].
# Try moving UP to exit the container (would go to row 36)
action(['UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'N':
        r1, c1 = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print(f"After UP: N at [{r1},{c1}]")
    if n['color'] == 'g':
        r1, c1 = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        r2, c2 = max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print(f"  g node {n['id']}: [{r1},{c1}]-[{r2},{c2}], children={n['children']}")

# Check if anything else changed
print("\nAll non-background objects:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] not in ['G', 'W', 'c', 'B', 'g']:
        r1, c1 = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        r2, c2 = max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']), max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print(f"  {n['color']}: [{r1},{c1}]-[{r2},{c2}], px={n['pixels']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
